only_native_txt <- if (!n_skip) "Every cuplyr entry is computation only, and none fell back to the CPU in this run." else
  paste0("Every cuplyr entry that is timed is computation only. Cells that run on the CPU fallback (download, an R loop, re-upload) are not timed: ", skip_summary, ".",
         if (median_skipped) " The median table and plot carry a note instead of a number for cuplyr." else "")

# ---- run configuration -------------------------------------------------------
cfg_defaults <- tryCatch(rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("rolling-window.qmd")$params, error = function(e) NULL)
cfg_names <- c("n_rows", "widths", "times", "times_custom", "cell_budget", "probe_limit", "group_rows",
               "n_groups", "group_width", "ext_rows", "ext_times", "stats")
cfg_diff <- if (is.null(cfg_defaults)) character() else Filter(nzchar, vapply(cfg_names, function(nm) {
  a <- sort(as.character(unlist(params[[nm]]))); b <- sort(as.character(unlist(cfg_defaults[[nm]])))
  # numbers compare as numbers (the default 1e7 is read from YAML as text)
  same <- identical(a, b) || (!anyNA(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(c(a, b)))) && isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(a), as.numeric(b))))
  if (same) "" else sprintf("%s = %s (default %s)", nm, paste(unlist(params[[nm]]), collapse = " / "), paste(unlist(cfg_defaults[[nm]]), collapse = " / "))
}, ""))
cfg_txt <- if (!length(cfg_diff)) "These are the defaults of the document, with no parameter overridden" else
  paste0("Parameters differing from the defaults: ", join_and(cfg_diff))

# ---- threads: what each setting actually did ------------------------------------
cells_w <- cells[cells$width == w_mid, ]
grp_lab <- "grouped mean"; ung_lab <- paste(ext_txt, "ungrouped mean")
thr_all <- rbind(
  data.frame(kind = "main", where = paste0(rows_txt, " rows, w=", w_mid), statistic = cells_w$stat, fn = cells_w$fn,
             med = cells_w$med, q25 = cells_w$q25, q75 = cells_w$q75, n = cells_w$n, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  { e <- ext[ext$width == w_mid, ]
    data.frame(kind = ifelse(e$experiment == "grouped mean", "grouped", "ungrouped"),
               where = paste0(ifelse(e$experiment == "grouped mean", grp_lab, ung_lab), ", w=", w_mid),
               statistic = "mean", fn = e$fn, med = e$median_ms, q25 = e$q25_ms, q75 = e$q75_ms, n = e$times,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) })
default_threads <- function(fn) {
  pkg <- rw_threaded_pkg(fn)
  if (is.na(pkg)) return(NA_character_)
  switch(pkg, data.table = paste0(n_dt_threads, " (setDTthreads)"), RcppRoll = paste0(n_rr_threads, " (OpenMP)"),
         roll = paste0(n_roll_threads, " (RcppParallel)"))
}
thr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(grep("1 thread\\)$", thr_all$fn), function(i) {
  b <- thr_all[i, ]
  a <- thr_all[thr_all$where == b$where & thr_all$statistic == b$statistic & thr_all$fn == rw_base_label(b$fn), ]
  if (nrow(a) != 1L) return(NULL)
  ratio <- b$med / a$med
  data.frame(kind = b$kind, where = b$where, statistic = b$statistic, entry = a$fn, threads = default_threads(a$fn),
             default_med = a$med, default_q25 = a$q25, default_q75 = a$q75, one_med = b$med, one_q25 = b$q25,
             one_q75 = b$q75, ratio = ratio, n_default = a$n, n_one = b$n,
             class = if (ratio >= thr_yes) "scales" else if (ratio <= thr_no) "flat" else "weak", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
thr <- thr[order(match(thr$kind, c("main", "grouped", "ungrouped")), thr$entry, match(thr$statistic, c(stat_order, "custom"))), ]
rownames(thr) <- NULL
thr_table <- data.frame(
  experiment = thr$where, statistic = thr$statistic, entry = thr$entry, default_threads = thr$threads,
  default_ms = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt_ms(thr$default_med), fmt_ms(thr$default_q25), fmt_ms(thr$default_q75)),
  one_thread_ms = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt_ms(thr$one_med), fmt_ms(thr$one_q25), fmt_ms(thr$one_q75)),
  ratio = sprintf("%.2f", thr$ratio),
  scales = ifelse(thr$class == "scales", sprintf("yes (%s slower at 1 thread)", fmt_x(thr$ratio)),
                  ifelse(thr$class == "flat", "no", "weakly")), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
samples_txt <- function(n) { r <- range(n); if (r[1] == r[2]) as.character(r[1]) else paste0(r[1], "-", r[2]) }
thr_main_std <- thr[thr$kind == "main" & thr$statistic != "custom", ]
thr_main_cus <- thr[thr$kind == "main" & thr$statistic == "custom", ]
n_thr_std <- samples_txt(c(thr_main_std$n_default, thr_main_std$n_one))
n_thr_cus <- samples_txt(c(thr_main_cus$n_default, thr_main_cus$n_one))
n_thr_ext <- samples_txt(c(thr$n_default[thr$kind != "main"], thr$n_one[thr$kind != "main"]))
within_pct <- function(r) fmt_pct(max(abs(r - 1)))

froll_one <- function(entry, statistic) {
  if (entry == "data.table") code(paste0("froll", statistic))
  else if (entry == "data.table (exact)") code("frollsum(algo = \"exact\")")
  else if (entry == "data.table::frollapply") code("frollapply") else code(entry)
}
froll_group <- function(rows) {
  plain <- rows$statistic[rows$entry == "data.table"]
  others <- vapply(which(rows$entry != "data.table"), function(i) froll_one(rows$entry[i], rows$statistic[i]), "")
  join_and(c(if (length(plain)) code(paste0("froll", paste(plain, collapse = "/"))), others))
}
scaled_group <- function(rows) {
  join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) sprintf("%s (%s)", froll_one(rows$entry[i], rows$statistic[i]), fmt_x(rows$ratio[i])), ""))
}

rr <- thr[thr$entry == "RcppRoll" & thr$kind == "main", ]
rr_ung <- thr[thr$entry == "RcppRoll" & thr$kind == "ungrouped", ]
rr_scales <- nrow(rr) > 0 && all(rr$class == "scales")
rr_runs <- if (rr_scales) "runs on" else "is set to"
rr_claim <- if (rr_scales) sprintf("scales with them: %s slower at one thread for every statistic at w=%s", range_x(rr$ratio, 0), w_mid) else
  if (all(rr$class == "flat")) sprintf("does not use them: its one-thread control is within %s of the default for every statistic at w=%s", within_pct(rr$ratio), w_mid) else
  sprintf("scales for %s but not for %s at w=%s", join_and(rr$statistic[rr$class == "scales"]), join_and(rr$statistic[rr$class != "scales"]), w_mid)
rr_reading <- if (rr_scales) sprintf("scales on every statistic (%s slower at one thread at w=%s%s)", range_x(rr$ratio),
                                      w_mid, if (nrow(rr_ung)) sprintf("; %s at %s rows", fmt_x(rr_ung$ratio[1]), ext_txt) else "") else
  sprintf("does not scale on every statistic: %s", rr_claim)

dt_rows <- thr[grepl("^data\\.table", thr$entry) & thr$kind == "main", ]
dt_flat <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "flat", ]
dt_scale <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "scales", ]
dt_weak <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "weak", ]
dt_by <- thr[thr$kind == "grouped" & grepl("^data\\.table", thr$entry), ]
dt_ung <- thr[thr$kind == "ungrouped" & thr$entry == "data.table", ]
by_flat <- nrow(dt_by) > 0 && all(dt_by$class == "flat")
dt_within <- within_pct(c(dt_flat$ratio, if (by_flat) dt_by$ratio))
dt_lead <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("data.table's %s%s ran effectively on one thread", froll_group(dt_flat),
                                      if (by_flat) paste0(" and its ", code("by="), " evaluation") else "") else
  "data.table's calls all scaled with threads"
dt_only <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("Only %s scale.", scaled_group(dt_scale)) else "None of its calls scaled."
dt_weak_txt <- if (nrow(dt_weak)) sprintf(" Borderline (ratio between %s and %s): %s.", thr_no, thr_yes, scaled_group(dt_weak)) else ""
dt_scale_names <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(dt_scale)), function(i) froll_one(dt_scale$entry[i], dt_scale$statistic[i]), "")) else "none of its calls"
dt_scale_sentence <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("data.table's %s scale", dt_scale_names) else "none of data.table's calls scaled"
dt_reading <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("scales only for %s.", scaled_group(dt_scale)) else "does not scale for any of its calls."
dt_flat_reading <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("%s (ratio %s)%s do not%s", froll_group(dt_flat), range_num(dt_flat$ratio),
                                              if (by_flat) sprintf(" and the grouped %s call (%s)", code("by = g"), sprintf("%.2f", dt_by$ratio[1])) else "",
                                              ": that is the figure the grouped comparison below depends on.") else ""

roll_rows <- thr[thr$entry == "roll" & thr$kind == "main", ]
roll_ung <- thr[thr$entry == "roll" & thr$kind == "ungrouped", ]
roll_flat <- nrow(roll_rows) > 0 && all(roll_rows$class == "flat")
roll_lead <- if (roll_flat) "roll ran effectively on one thread" else sprintf("roll used extra threads for %s", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class != "flat"]))
roll_claim <- if (roll_flat) sprintf("for every statistic (1-thread vs default within %s at w=%s), although RcppParallel reports %s available threads",
                                      within_pct(roll_rows$ratio), w_mid, n_roll_threads) else
  sprintf("(ratio %s at w=%s); RcppParallel reports %s available threads", range_num(roll_rows$ratio), w_mid, n_roll_threads)
roll_reading <- if (roll_flat) sprintf("does not scale on any statistic (ratio %s)%s.", range_num(roll_rows$ratio),
                                       if (nrow(roll_ung)) sprintf(", including at %s rows", ext_txt) else "") else
  sprintf("scales on %s (ratio %s).", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class == "scales"]), range_num(roll_rows$ratio))

n_omp <- omp[["roll", "symbols"]]
roll_omp_txt <- if (!is.na(n_omp) && n_omp > 0) {
  paste0("(", code("roll.so"), " also imports ", words(n_omp), " OpenMP runtime ", plural(n_omp, "symbol"), " (", code("GOMP*"), ", ", code("omp_*"), "), which ", code("setThreadOptions()"),
         " does not govern; the default online vector workers used here are sequential loops, and only roll's offline workers are RcppParallel workers",
         if (roll_flat) ", so the one-thread reading holds.)" else ", which may explain the scaling.)")
} else ""
unctl <- c("RollingWindow", "slider", "zoo", "runner")
unctl <- unctl[ver[unctl] != "not installed"]
unctl_clean <- !anyNA(omp[unctl, c("symbols", "tbb")]) && all(omp[unctl, c("symbols", "tbb")] == 0)
runstats_pure <- ver[["runstats"]] != "not installed" && identical(unname(omp["runstats", "compiled"]), 0)
nm_ok <- nzchar(Sys.which("nm"))
unctl_check <- if (!nm_ok) {
  "Their compiled code could not be checked here (no `nm`); I treat them as single-threaded, which is an assumption, not a timing."
} else if (unctl_clean) {
  sprintf("Their compiled code imports no OpenMP or TBB runtime symbol (%s on the installed shared object, run by this document)%s. I treat them as single-threaded; that is a static check, not a timing.",
          code("nm -D --undefined-only"), if (runstats_pure) " and runstats is pure R" else "")
} else {
  bad <- unctl[!is.na(omp[unctl, "symbols"]) & (omp[unctl, "symbols"] > 0 | omp[unctl, "tbb"] > 0)]
  sprintf("But the compiled code of %s imports OpenMP or TBB runtime symbols (%s), so they may use threads that this report did not control.",
          join_and(bad), code("nm -D --undefined-only"))
}

# ---- who is fastest ---------------------------------------------------------------
cpu_bases <- function(stat) {
  f <- unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat])
  f[!grepl("1 thread|^cuplyr|exact|::", f)]
}
view_def <- function(stat, width) { b <- cpu_bases(stat); stats::setNames(vapply(b, function(e) med(stat, e, width), 0), b) }
view_1t <- function(stat, width) {
  b <- cpu_bases(stat)
  stats::setNames(vapply(b, function(e) med(stat, if (!is.na(rw_threaded_pkg(e))) rw_one_thread_label(e) else e, width), 0), b)
}
win_def <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) names(which.min(view_def(s, w_mid))), "")
win_1t <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) names(which.min(view_1t(s, w_mid))), "")
n_dt_wins <- sum(win_1t == "data.table")
headline_verdict <- if (n_dt_wins == n_st) "holds" else if (n_dt_wins == n_st - 1L) "holds (with an exception, below)" else
  if (n_dt_wins > n_st / 2) "holds only in part" else "does not hold"
rr_default_wins <- win_def == "RcppRoll"
lead_clause <- if (all(rr_default_wins) && rr_scales) sprintf("comes from its %s OpenMP threads", n_rr_threads) else
  if (all(rr_default_wins)) "is not explained by its threads (its one-thread control is about as fast)" else
  sprintf("is limited to %s of %s statistics", words(sum(rr_default_wins)), words(n_st))
rr_leader <- if (all(rr_default_wins)) "RcppRoll was the fastest package in every statistic" else
  sprintf("RcppRoll was the fastest package in %s of %s statistics", words(sum(rr_default_wins)), words(n_st))
rr_default_list <- paste(vapply(stats_main, function(s) {
  if (win_def[[s]] == "RcppRoll") sprintf("%s %s ms (data.table %s)", s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med(s, "data.table", w_mid)))
  else sprintf("%s %s ms, but %s was faster (%s)", s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll", w_mid)), win_def[[s]], fmt_ms(min(view_def(s, w_mid))))
}, ""), collapse = ", ")
rr1_list <- join_and(vapply(stats_main, function(s) paste(s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid))), ""))
rr1_ratio <- sprintf("(%s %s)", range_x(rr$ratio, 0), if (all(rr$ratio > 1)) "slower" else "different")

dt1_rr1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats_main, function(s) data.frame(stat = s, width = widths,
  v = vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(s, "data.table (1 thread)", w), trip(s, "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w)), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
dt1_rr1_txt <- pattern_txt(dt1_rr1)
dt_single_stats <- intersect(c("mean", "sum", "min", "max"), dt_flat$statistic[dt_flat$entry == "data.table"])
dt_single_txt <- if (length(dt_single_stats)) sprintf(" (whose %s calls are single-threaded anyway)", paste(dt_single_stats, collapse = "/")) else ""
dt1_med <- slash(med_w("median", "data.table (1 thread)")); rr1_med <- slash(med_w("median", "RcppRoll (1 thread)"))
rw_med <- slash(med_w("median", "RollingWindow"))
rw_v <- vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip("median", "RollingWindow", w), trip("median", "data.table (1 thread)", w)), "")
rw_med_txt <- runs_txt(rw_v, widths, vocab_ahead)
dt_med_ratio <- med("median", "data.table", w_mid) / med("median", "RcppRoll", w_mid)
dt_med_txt <- sprintf("%s %s threads data.table's median (%s) is %s the %s-thread RcppRoll (%s).",
  if (dt_med_ratio >= 1 + th_level) "Even with its" else "With its", n_dt_threads, ms_s(med("median", "data.table", w_mid)),
  if (dt_med_ratio >= 1 + th_level) paste("about", fmt_xr(dt_med_ratio), "slower than") else if (dt_med_ratio <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) paste("about", fmt_xr(1 / dt_med_ratio), "faster than") else "level with",
  n_rr_threads, ms_s(med("median", "RcppRoll", w_mid)))
exc <- stats_main[win_1t != "data.table"]
exc_txt <- if (!length(exc)) sprintf("At equal, one-thread conditions data.table is the fastest at w=%s in every statistic.", w_mid) else
  paste(vapply(exc, function(s) {
    v <- sort(view_1t(s, w_mid))
    lab <- function(e) ifelse(is.na(vapply(e, rw_threaded_pkg, "")), e, paste("one-thread", e))
    top <- head(names(v), 3)
    sprintf("%s is the exception: %s (%s) is fastest, then %s%s.", s, lab(top[1]), ms_s(v[[1]]),
            join_and(sprintf("%s (%s)", lab(top[-1]), fmt_ms(v[top[-1]]))),
            if (s == "sd") "; the post had no data.table sd" else "")
  }, ""), collapse = " ")

# ---- roll, slider, zoo, runner, custom ---------------------------------------------
roll_ms <- merge_equal("roll", stats_main)
beats <- function(stat, dt_fn, other) is_faster(vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(stat, dt_fn, w), trip(stat, other, w)), ""))
dt_beats_roll_def <- all(vapply(c("median", "sd"), function(s) all(beats(s, "data.table", "roll")), TRUE))
dt_beats_roll_1t <- all(vapply(c("median", "sd"), function(s) all(beats(s, "data.table (1 thread)", "roll (1 thread)")), TRUE))
roll_vs_dt_txt <- if (dt_beats_roll_def && dt_beats_roll_1t) {
  sprintf("data.table %s now has %s and %s and beats it on those (at one thread, too: median %s vs %s ms, sd %s vs %s)",
    dt_minor, code("frollmedian"), code("frollsd"), fmt_ms(med("median", "data.table (1 thread)", w_mid)),
    fmt_ms(med("median", "roll (1 thread)", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table (1 thread)", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "roll (1 thread)", w_mid)))
} else if (dt_beats_roll_def) {
  sprintf("data.table %s beats it on median and sd at default settings, but not at one thread", dt_minor)
} else {
  sprintf("data.table %s does not beat it on both median and sd in this run (median %s vs %s ms, sd %s vs %s)", dt_minor,
    fmt_ms(med("median", "data.table", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("median", "roll", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "roll", w_mid)))
}
roll_ran_txt <- if (roll_flat) "roll ran on one thread for every statistic." else sprintf("roll used extra threads for %s.", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class != "flat"]))

fn_stats <- function(fn) { s <- unique(cells$stat[cells$fn == fn]); intersect(stat_order, s) }
at_w <- function(fn, w, stats = fn_stats(fn)) vapply(stats, function(s) med(s, fn, w), 0)
slower_than_dt <- function(fn) {
  s <- intersect(fn_stats(fn), stats_main)
  all(vapply(s, function(st) is_slower(verdict(trip(st, fn, w_mid), trip(st, "data.table", w_mid))), TRUE))
}
slider_grows <- all(vapply(fn_stats("slider"), function(s) med(s, "slider", w_hi) > th_grow * med(s, "slider", w_lo), TRUE))
slider_txt <- sprintf("slider (%s at w=%s; %s at w=%s, %s at w=%s%s) %s", range_ms(at_w("slider", w_mid)), w_mid,
  range_ms(at_w("slider", w_lo)), w_lo, range_ms(at_w("slider", w_hi)), w_hi, if (slider_grows) ", growing with the width" else "",
  if (slower_than_dt("slider")) "is for custom alignment, not speed" else "is not slower than data.table in every statistic")
zoo_runner_slow <- slower_than_dt("zoo") && slower_than_dt("runner")
zoo_runner_txt <- sprintf("zoo (%s) and runner (%s at w=%s, %s at w=%s) %s", range_ms(at_w("zoo", w_mid)),
  range_ms(at_w("runner", w_mid)), w_mid, range_ms(at_w("runner", w_hi)), w_hi,
  if (zoo_runner_slow) "are slow" else "are not slower than data.table in every statistic")
cus_fa <- med("custom", "data.table::frollapply", w_mid); cus_fa1 <- med("custom", "data.table::frollapply (1 thread)", w_mid)
cus_zoo <- med_w("custom", "zoo::rollapply")
cus_zoo_grows <- length(na.omit(cus_zoo)) > 1 && all(diff(na.omit(cus_zoo)) > 0)
opt_equiv <- med_w("sum", "data.table")
cus_grow_txt <- if (cus_zoo_grows) "growing with the width" else "not growing with the width"
cus_verdict <- if (min(c(cus_fa, cus_zoo), na.rm = TRUE) > th_avoid * max(opt_equiv)) "Avoid them." else "They are not clearly slower in this run."

# ---- where cuplyr lands --------------------------------------------------------------
cup_native <- c("mean", "sum", "min", "max")
cup_native <- intersect(cup_native, stats_main)
# a cell that was not timed (skipped or failed) is left out of the range
nat_txt <- paste(vapply(widths, function(w) {
  v <- vapply(cup_native, function(s) med(s, "cuplyr", w), 0)
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return("not timed")
  a <- fmt_2(min(v)); b <- fmt_2(max(v)); if (a == b) a else paste0(a, "-", b)
}, ""), collapse = " / ")
widths_slash <- paste(widths, collapse = " / ")
excl_cup <- c("cuplyr", "cuplyr (froll alias)")
# RcppRoll runs on many threads by default when its one-thread control scales (the
# threads table says so); name it that way wherever it is compared
lab_cpu <- function(fn) ifelse(fn == "RcppRoll" & rr_scales, paste0(n_rr_threads, "-thread RcppRoll"), fn)
vs_text <- function(stat, mine = "cuplyr") {
  comp <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat]), excl_cup)
  pats <- vapply(comp, function(e) paste(vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(stat, mine, w), trip(stat, e, w)), ""), collapse = "|"), "")
  groups <- split(comp, factor(pats, levels = unique(pats)))
  paste(vapply(names(groups), function(p) {
    v <- strsplit(p, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]; v[v == "NA"] <- NA
    sprintf("against %s, %s is %s", join_and(sprintf("%s (%s)", lab_cpu(groups[[p]]), fmt_ms(vapply(groups[[p]], function(e) med(stat, e, w_mid), 0)))), mine, runs_txt(v, widths))
  }, ""), collapse = "; ")
}
mean_vs <- vs_text("mean")
rank_of <- function(stat, width, fn = "cuplyr") {
  v <- vapply(setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat]), setdiff(excl_cup, fn)), function(e) med(stat, e, width), 0)
  c(rank = unname(rank(v)[fn]), n = length(v))
}
mean_rank <- rank_of("mean", w_mid)
rank_pos <- if (is.na(mean_rank[["rank"]])) "not ranked (its mean at this width was not timed)" else
  if (mean_rank[["rank"]] / mean_rank[["n"]] <= th_front) "near the front" else
  if (mean_rank[["rank"]] / mean_rank[["n"]] >= 1 - th_front) "near the back" else "mid-pack"
rank_detail <- if (is.na(mean_rank[["rank"]])) "" else sprintf(" (rank %s of %s entries for mean at w=%s)", mean_rank[["rank"]], mean_rank[["n"]], w_mid)
sum_v <- vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip("sum", "cuplyr", w), trip("sum", "roll", w)), "")
sum_roll_txt <- sprintf("For sum against roll, cuplyr is %s (%s vs %s ms at w=%s).", runs_txt(sum_v), fmt_ms(med("sum", "cuplyr", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sum", "roll", w_mid)), w_mid)
mm_win <- widths[vapply(widths, function(w) all(vapply(c("min", "max"), function(s) is_faster(verdict(trip(s, "cuplyr", w), trip(s, "data.table", w))), TRUE)), TRUE)]
mm_w <- if (length(mm_win)) mm_win[1] else w_mid
mm_txt <- sprintf("For min and max it beats data.table %s (cuplyr vs data.table at w=%s: %s)", if (!length(mm_win)) "at no width" else if (length(mm_win) == length(widths)) "at every width" else paste("only at", join_and(paste0("w=", mm_win))),
  mm_w, join_and(vapply(c("min", "max"), function(s) sprintf("%s vs %s ms for %s", fmt_ms(med(s, "cuplyr", mm_w)), fmt_ms(med(s, "data.table", mm_w)), s), "")))
sd_ms <- med_w("sd", "cuplyr")
sd_ranks <- lapply(widths, function(w) rank_of("sd", w))
rank_word <- function(r) if (is.na(r[["rank"]])) "not timed" else if (r[["rank"]] == 1) "fastest" else if (r[["rank"]] == r[["n"]]) "slowest of all" else ordinal(r[["rank"]])
sd_rank_txt <- join_and(mapply(function(r, w) sprintf("%s at w=%s", rank_word(r), w), sd_ranks, widths))
sd_last <- isTRUE(sd_ranks[[3]][["rank"]] == sd_ranks[[3]][["n"]])
sd_others_hi <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == "sd"]), excl_cup)
sd_next <- sd_others_hi[which.max(vapply(sd_others_hi, function(e) med("sd", e, w_hi), 0))]
sd_tail <- if (sd_last) sprintf(" (data.table %s; the slowest other entry is %s, %s ms)", fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table", w_hi)), sd_next, fmt_ms(med("sd", sd_next, w_hi))) else ""
sd_line <- paste0(sd_rank_txt, sd_tail)
sd_sent <- if (all(is.na(sd_ms))) "cuplyr sd was not timed in this run (see the skipped cells)." else
  sprintf("cuplyr sd takes %s ms: %s.", slash(sd_ms), sd_line)
fb_txt <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("cuplyr %s is not timed: it has no GPU path and runs on the CPU fallback, so it is left out of every figure here (F3).", code("roll_median()")) else
  if (has_cell("median", "cuplyr", w_mid)) sprintf("cuplyr median takes %s ms (native in this run).", slash(med_w("median", "cuplyr"))) else
  "cuplyr has no median entry in this run."

# ---- how cuplyr scales with the width ------------------------------------------------
trend <- function(stat, fn) { r <- med(stat, fn, w_hi) / med(stat, fn, w_lo); if (is.na(r)) NA_character_ else if (r >= th_trend) "grows" else if (r <= 1 / th_trend) "shrinks" else "flat" }
cup_grow_ratio <- vapply(c("mean", "sd"), function(s) med(s, "cuplyr", w_hi) / med(s, "cuplyr", w_lo), 0)
# unknown when a cuplyr mean or sd cell at the narrowest or widest width was not timed
cup_grow_known <- !anyNA(cup_grow_ratio)
cup_grows <- cup_grow_known && all(cup_grow_ratio >= th_trend)
grow_unknown_why <- sprintf("a cuplyr mean or sd cell at w=%s or w=%s was not timed", w_lo, w_hi)
# "1.99 / 2.05 / 4.10 ms", with "not timed" for a missing cell
fig_w <- function(v) if (all(is.na(v))) "not timed" else paste(paste(ifelse(is.na(v), "not timed", fmt_ms(v)), collapse = " / "), "ms")
grow_figs <- sprintf("mean %s; sd %s", fig_w(med_w("mean", "cuplyr")), fig_w(sd_ms))
trend_fns <- c("data.table", "data.table (exact)", "roll", "RcppRoll")
trend_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(trend_fns, function(f) data.frame(fn = f, stat = fn_stats(f)[fn_stats(f) %in% stat_order], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
trend_df$trend <- mapply(trend, trend_df$stat, trend_df$fn)
trend_items <- function(kind) {
  d <- trend_df[trend_df$trend %in% kind, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(character())
  unlist(lapply(unique(d$fn), function(f) {
    s <- d$stat[d$fn == f]
    all_s <- fn_stats(f)[fn_stats(f) %in% stat_order]
    if (f == "data.table (exact)") "data.table's exact sum"
    else if (length(s) == length(all_s) && length(s) > 1) lab_cpu(f) else sprintf("%s's %s", lab_cpu(f), paste(s, collapse = "/"))
  }))
}
trend_flat <- join_and(trend_items("flat")); trend_down <- join_and(trend_items("shrinks")); trend_up <- join_and(trend_items("grows"))
width_ratio <- w_hi / w_mid
sd_up <- med("sd", "cuplyr", w_hi) / med("sd", "cuplyr", w_mid)
grow_txt <- if (!cup_grow_known) sprintf("Whether cuplyr's cost grows with the window width is not known from this run (%s; %s)", grow_unknown_why, grow_figs) else
  if (cup_grows) sprintf("cuplyr's cost grows with the window width (%s)", grow_figs) else
  sprintf("cuplyr's cost does not grow strongly with the window width (%s)", grow_figs)
trend_txt <- sprintf("%s are flat in the width%s%s",
  trend_flat, if (nzchar(trend_down)) sprintf(" (%s get faster with the width", trend_down) else "",
  if (nzchar(trend_up)) sprintf("%s %s get slower)", if (nzchar(trend_down)) ";" else " (", trend_up) else if (nzchar(trend_down)) ")" else "")
incr_txt <- if (cup_grows) "\"The kernel is not incremental\" is my inference from that scaling; I did not read or profile the kernel (F2)." else "I did not read or profile the kernel (F2)."
rescan_txt <- if (!cup_grow_known) "" else if (cup_grows) {
  if (is.na(sd_up)) "That pattern is what a kernel that rescans each window would produce." else
    sprintf("That pattern is what a kernel that rescans each window would produce (sd goes up %s for a %s wider window).", fmt_x(sd_up), fmt_x(width_ratio, 0))
} else "That is not the pattern a kernel that rescans each window would produce."

# ---- grouped and large ------------------------------------------------------------------
g_cup <- ext_med(grp_lab, "cuplyr", group_width); g_dt <- ext_med(grp_lab, "data.table (by = g)", group_width)
g_sl <- ext_med(grp_lab, "slider (grouped_df)", group_width); g_dt1 <- ext_med(grp_lab, "data.table (by = g, 1 thread)", group_width)
g_dir <- function(r) if (is.na(r)) "not comparable with" else if (r >= 1 + th_level) sprintf("about %s faster than", fmt_xr(r)) else if (r <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) sprintf("about %s slower than", fmt_xr(1 / r)) else "level with"
g_txt <- if (is.na(g_cup)) sprintf("cuplyr was not timed (%s), so there is no grouped comparison; data.table by group took %s ms and slider %s ms",
                                   if (any(sk$chunk == "bench-ext" & sk$stat == "grouped mean")) "its probe call fell back to the CPU" else "its cell failed",
                                   fmt_ms(g_dt), fmt_ms(g_sl)) else
  sprintf("cuplyr %s ms vs data.table by group %s ms and slider %s ms, so cuplyr is %s data.table and %s slider, computation only",
          fmt_ms(g_cup), fmt_ms(g_dt), fmt_ms(g_sl), g_dir(g_dt / g_cup), g_dir(g_sl / g_cup))
g_fast <- isTRUE(g_cup < min(g_dt, g_sl, g_dt1, na.rm = TRUE))
by_verb <- if (by_flat) "ran effectively single-threaded" else "used threads"
by_tail <- if (by_flat && !is.na(g_cup)) sprintf(", so the %s is the GPU against **one CPU thread making %s per-group calls**, not against %s threads", fmt_xr(g_dt / g_cup), fmt_int(n_groups), n_dt_threads) else ""
ung_fns <- unique(ext$fn[ext$experiment == "ungrouped mean"])
thr_label <- function(fn) {
  base <- fn
  r <- thr[thr$kind == "ungrouped" & thr$entry == base, ]
  if (nrow(r) && r$class[1] == "scales") paste0(sub(" .*", "", r$threads[1]), "-thread ", base) else base
}
ung_at <- function(w) {
  others <- setdiff(ung_fns, "cuplyr")
  data.frame(fn = others, med = vapply(others, function(e) ext_med("ungrouped mean", e, w), 0),
             v = vapply(others, function(e) verdict(ext_trip("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w), ext_trip("ungrouped mean", e, w)), ""),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
# widths with a cuplyr figure (a skipped or failed cell has none)
ung_have <- vapply(widths, function(w) !is.na(ext_med("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w)), TRUE)
ung_fast <- ung_have & vapply(widths, function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); all(is_faster(d$v)) }, TRUE)
ung_txt <- function(w) {
  d <- ung_at(w)
  cup <- ext_med("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w)
  scaled <- d$fn[grepl("1 thread", d$fn)]
  scaled <- scaled[vapply(scaled, function(e) { b <- rw_base_label(e); r <- thr[thr$kind == "ungrouped" & thr$entry == b, ]; nrow(r) > 0 && r$class[1] == "scales" }, TRUE)]
  dflt <- d[!grepl("1 thread", d$fn), ]
  if (all(is_faster(d$v))) {
    sprintf("%s ms vs %s%s", fmt_ms(cup), join_and(sprintf("%s %s", vapply(dflt$fn, thr_label, ""), fmt_ms(dflt$med))),
            if (length(scaled)) paste0("; ", join_and(sprintf("one-thread %s %s", rw_base_label(scaled), fmt_ms(d$med[match(scaled, d$fn)])))) else "")
  } else {
    ahead <- dflt[is_slower(dflt$v), ]; lvl <- dflt[dflt$v == "level" | grepl("slightly", dflt$v), ]
    sprintf("%s ms vs %s%s", fmt_ms(cup), join_and(sprintf("%s %s", vapply(ahead$fn, thr_label, ""), fmt_ms(ahead$med))),
            if (nrow(lvl)) sprintf("; level with %s", join_and(sprintf("%s %s", lvl$fn, fmt_ms(lvl$med)))) else "")
  }
}
ung_fast_txt <- join_and(vapply(widths[ung_fast], function(w) sprintf("w=%s (%s)", w, ung_txt(w)), ""))
ung_slow_txt <- join_and(vapply(widths[ung_have & !ung_fast], function(w) sprintf("w=%s (%s)", w, ung_txt(w)), ""))
ung_beats_rr <- any(vapply(widths[ung_fast], function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); "RcppRoll" %in% d$fn && is_faster(d$v[d$fn == "RcppRoll"]) }, TRUE))
ung_sent <- paste0(
  sprintf("At %s ungrouped rows (one size) cuplyr is ", ext_txt),
  if (any(ung_fast)) sprintf("fastest at %s", ung_fast_txt) else "not the fastest at any width",
  if (any(ung_have & !ung_fast)) sprintf("%s %s", if (any(ung_fast)) ", and loses at" else ":", ung_slow_txt) else "",
  if (any(!ung_have)) sprintf("; it was not timed at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", widths[!ung_have]))) else "", ".")
peak_bytes <- suppressWarnings(max(ext$peak_gpu_bytes, na.rm = TRUE))
peak_txt <- if (!is.finite(peak_bytes)) sprintf("No %s-row cuplyr call was measured for peak GPU memory", ext_txt) else
  sprintf("Peak GPU memory for the %s-row call was %s, %s inside %s GB", ext_txt, fmt_mb(peak_bytes),
          if (peak_bytes < th_mem * gpu_gb * 1e9) "well" else "not far", gpu_gb)

ung_loss <- ung_have & vapply(widths, function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); d <- d[!grepl("1 thread", d$fn), ]; any(is_slower(d$v)) }, TRUE)
net_fast <- c(if (g_fast) sprintf("the grouped configuration (%s groups)", groups_txt),
              if (any(ung_fast)) sprintf("%s rows with windows of %s", ext_txt, join_and(widths[ung_fast])))
net_slow <- c(if (!g_fast && !is.na(g_cup)) "the grouped configuration",
              if (any(ung_have & !ung_fast)) sprintf("%s rows with windows of %s", ext_txt, join_and(widths[ung_have & !ung_fast])))
# the scope of the large-configuration wins: narrow windows only when every width it
# won is narrower than every width it did not (among the widths it was timed at)
ung_not_fast <- widths[ung_have & !ung_fast]
net_scope <- if (any(ung_fast) && length(ung_not_fast) && max(widths[ung_fast]) < min(ung_not_fast)) "narrow windows" else "the widths where it was fastest"
net_lose <- if (any(ung_loss)) sprintf(", and it loses at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", widths[ung_loss]))) else
  if (length(net_slow)) sprintf(", and it is not clearly ahead for %s", join_and(net_slow)) else ""
net_txt <- paste0(
  if (length(net_fast)) sprintf("In the larger configurations measured it was the fastest entry for %s%s", join_and(net_fast),
                                if (ung_beats_rr) sprintf(", including against %s at %s rows", lab_cpu("RcppRoll"), ext_txt) else "") else "In the larger configurations measured it was not the fastest entry anywhere",
  "; that is one grouped configuration, one large size", if (any(ung_fast)) paste(" and", net_scope) else "", net_lose, ". All of it only when the data already lives on the GPU.")

# ---- per-call overhead ----------------------------------------------------------------------
call_labels <- names(rw_overhead_calls(w_mid))
lab_plain <- call_labels[1]; lab_roll <- call_labels[2]; lab_cum <- call_labels[3]
oh_med <- function(label, rows) stats::median(oh$ms[oh$stat == "overhead" & oh$fn == label & oh$n_rows == rows])
floor_df <- oh[oh$stat != "overhead" & oh$n_rows == small_rows, ]
floor_by_stat <- tapply(floor_df$ms, floor_df$stat, stats::median)
floor_ms <- stats::median(floor_by_stat)
plain_small <- oh_med(lab_plain, small_rows); roll_small <- oh_med(lab_roll, small_rows); cum_small <- oh_med(lab_cum, small_rows)
plain_big <- oh_med(lab_plain, n_rows); roll_big <- oh_med(lab_roll, n_rows); cum_big <- oh_med(lab_cum, n_rows)
win_extra <- floor_ms - plain_small
cum_same <- isTRUE(abs(cum_small / roll_small - 1) < th_same)
kernel_txt <- if (cum_same) "not any single kernel" else "which may include part of the kernel's cost"
cum_vs_roll_txt <- if (anyNA(c(cum_small, roll_small))) "cumsum and roll_mean are not both timed here, so the extra cost is not split between the path and the kernel." else
  if (cum_same) sprintf("cumsum costs the same as roll_mean, so the extra %s ms (%s of the floor) belongs to the window-function path, not to any one kernel.", fmt_1(win_extra), fmt_pct(win_extra / floor_ms, 0)) else
  sprintf("cumsum and roll_mean differ here (%s vs %s ms), so part of the extra %s ms may belong to the kernel rather than to the window-function path.", fmt_ms(cum_small), fmt_ms(roll_small), fmt_1(win_extra))
floor_vs_dt <- { r <- floor_ms / med("mean", "data.table", w_mid); if (is.na(r)) "not comparable with" else if (r >= 1 + th_level) "larger than" else if (r <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) "smaller than" else "about the same as" }
floor_share <- floor_ms / med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo)
floor_share_txt <- if (is.na(floor_share)) sprintf("not set against the cuplyr mean at width %s here (not timed in this run)", w_lo) else
  sprintf("about %s of the %s ms measured at %s rows / width %s", fmt_pct(floor_share, 0), fmt_ms(med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo)), rows_txt, w_lo)
f4_share_txt <- if (is.na(floor_share)) "" else sprintf(", and the floor is about %s of the narrow-window rolling cost", fmt_pct(floor_share, 0))
n_floor_samples <- nrow(floor_df)
w_lo_vs_cum <- med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo) - cum_big
narrow_chain <- w_lo_vs_cum / med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo) < th_chain
# the narrow-window rolling mean against the cumsum mutate, at the post's size;
# either cell can be missing (not timed), and then nothing is compared
narrow_txt <- if (is.na(narrow_chain)) {
  sprintf("not compared with the %s mutate here, because %s was not timed", code("cumsum"),
          if (is.na(med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo))) "the narrow-window rolling mean" else "the cumsum mutate")
} else paste0(
  if (w_lo_vs_cum >= 0) sprintf("only %s ms above", fmt_ms(w_lo_vs_cum)) else sprintf("%s ms below", fmt_ms(-w_lo_vs_cum)),
  " the ", code("cumsum"), " mutate: ",
  if (narrow_chain) "at narrow widths, most of cuplyr's time at this size is the call chain and the copies, not the rolling kernel" else
    "at narrow widths the rolling kernel is a visible part of cuplyr's time at this size")

plan_nodes <- lapply(bench_overhead$plans, function(l) { x <- regmatches(l, regexpr("ast_[a-z_]+", l)); x })
plan_plain <- plan_nodes[[lab_plain]]; plan_win <- plan_nodes[[lab_roll]]
n_mat_plain <- sum(plan_plain != "ast_source"); n_mat_win <- sum(plan_win != "ast_source")
chain_win <- paste(plan_win, collapse = " <- "); chain_plain <- paste(plan_plain, collapse = " <- ")
# "a window node, a mutate node and a select node", from the captured plan
node_list <- join_and(paste("a", sub("^ast_", "", rev(plan_win[plan_win != "ast_source"])), "node"))

# memory: the decomposition of the bytes held after one eager window mutate
# a memory call that was skipped (CPU fallback) leaves NA figures, not an error
mem_na <- function(lab) data.frame(call = lab, n_rows = ext_rows, x_column_bytes = 8 * ext_rows, allocated_bytes = NA_real_,
                                   held_after_call_bytes = NA_real_, peak_bytes = NA_real_, held_after_gc_bytes = NA_real_)
mb <- mem_breakdown
mem_get <- function(lab) if (!is.null(mb) && any(mb$call == lab)) mb[mb$call == lab, ][1, ] else mem_na(lab)
mb_roll <- mem_get(lab_roll); mb_plain <- mem_get(lab_plain); mb_cum <- mem_get(lab_cum)
n_mem <- mb_roll$n_rows
mask_bytes <- function(n) ceiling(n / 512) * 64
col_b <- mb_roll$x_column_bytes
bytes_per_row <- col_b / n_mem
win_out <- 2 * col_b + mask_bytes(n_mem); mut_out <- 3 * col_b + 2 * mask_bytes(n_mem); sel_out <- 2 * col_b + mask_bytes(n_mem)
pred_held <- win_out + mut_out + sel_out
held_roll <- mb_roll$held_after_call_bytes; result_roll <- mb_roll$held_after_gc_bytes
decomp_txt <- if (is.na(held_roll)) "could not be checked here (the call was skipped)" else if (pred_held == held_roll) "matches the measured total exactly" else sprintf("differs from the measured total by %s B", fmt_int(abs(pred_held - held_roll)))
mem_lead <- if (isTRUE(pred_held == held_roll)) "GPU memory shows it, to the byte" else if (is.na(held_roll)) "GPU memory of the rolling call was not measured" else "GPU memory shows it, though not to the byte"
plain_pred <- 2 * col_b
held_peak_txt <- if (is.na(mb_roll$peak_bytes)) "not measured" else if (mb_roll$held_after_call_bytes == mb_roll$peak_bytes) "held = peak" else sprintf("held %s B, peak %s B", fmt_int(mb_roll$held_after_call_bytes), fmt_int(mb_roll$peak_bytes))
held_ratio <- held_roll / result_roll

# the no-gc() finding
failed_at <- mem_finding$failed_at_call; n_calls <- mem_finding$n_calls
oom_quote <- sub("^(GPU operation '[^']*' failed).*(std::bad_alloc: out_of_memory: CUDA).*$", "\\1 ... \\2", gsub("\\s+", " ", mem_finding$error))
oom_quote <- if (!is.na(failed_at) && grepl("out_of_memory", mem_finding$error)) oom_quote else NA_character_
gc_lead <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) paste("cuplyr needs the", code("gc()")) else paste("cuplyr is given the", code("gc()"), "too")
gc_need_txt <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) sprintf("%s back-to-back %s-row calls without it ran the %s GB card out of memory", words(n_calls), ext_txt, gpu_gb) else
  sprintf("%s back-to-back %s-row calls without it did not run the %s GB card out of memory in this run, but the intermediates still pile up until a collection", words(n_calls), ext_txt, gpu_gb)
f1_oom_txt <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) sprintf("%s back-to-back calls without %s ran out of memory at the %s (%s) on the %s GB card, with the results dropped each time",
                                             words(n_calls), code("gc()"), ordinal(failed_at), if (is.na(oom_quote)) "no error text" else paste0("\"", oom_quote, "\""), gpu_gb) else
  sprintf("%s back-to-back calls without %s did not run out of memory at this size on the %s GB card", words(n_calls), code("gc()"), gpu_gb)

# ---- Deviations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What the fence costs: the on and off calls were timed in alternation, so the
# difference is a paired one.
fence_df <- bench_fence$timings
have_fence <- !is.null(fence_df)
th_fence <- 1
if (have_fence) {
  f_on <- fence_df[fence_df$label == "on", ]; f_off <- fence_df[fence_df$label == "off", ]
  fence_on <- stats::median(f_on$ms); fence_off <- stats::median(f_off$ms)
  fence_diff <- stats::median(f_on$ms - f_off$ms[match(f_on$sample, f_off$sample)])
  fence_n <- nrow(f_on)
}
fence_txt <- if (have_fence) sprintf("the rolling mean at %s rows, w=%s, in %s ms with the fence and %s ms without, %s interleaved pairs, median paired difference %s ms",
                                      ext_txt, w_mid, fmt_ms(fence_on), fmt_ms(fence_off), fence_n, fmt_ms(fence_diff)) else
  "nothing: the cell was skipped (see the skipped cells)"
fence_cost <- if (!have_fence) "an unmeasured amount" else if (abs(fence_diff) < th_fence) sprintf("under %s ms", th_fence) else sprintf("about %s ms", fmt_ms(abs(fence_diff)))
probe_sample_cells <- sum(grepl("^one sample, and it is the cold first call", cells$note))
probe_txt <- if (probe_sample_cells == 0) "which no cell did" else sprintf("which %s %s did", words(probe_sample_cells), plural(probe_sample_cells, "cell"))
warmup_txt <- sprintf("%s; %s above %s s; %s above %s s", rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[1], rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[2], rw_warmup_tiers$above_s[2], rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[3], rw_warmup_tiers$above_s[3])

# runstats: the figures the results tables show, and the paired effect of the
# alignment shift from the side chunk (its own, interleaved samples)
rs <- bench_runstats$timings
have_rs <- !is.null(rs)
rs_main <- c(mean = med("mean", "runstats", w_mid), sd = med("sd", "runstats", w_mid))
rs_side <- function(stat, shift) stats::median(rs$ms[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == shift])
rs_pair <- function(stat) {
  o <- rs[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == "outside", ]; i <- rs[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == "inside", ]
  stats::median(i$ms[match(o$sample, i$sample)] - o$ms)
}
rs_within <- function(a, b) a / b <= th_x && a / b >= 1 / th_x
rs_txt <- if (have_rs) sprintf("Chunk %s timed the same two calls again with the shift inside the call, interleaved with the unshifted calls (%s pairs per statistic; these are that chunk's own samples, not the tables'). In those pairs the shift adds %s ms to the mean call (%s ms unshifted, %s ms shifted) and %s ms to the sd call (%s and %s ms), so the shift %s.",
  code("bench-runstats-shift"), length(unique(rs$sample[rs$stat == "mean"])), fmt_ms(rs_pair("mean")), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "inside")),
  fmt_ms(rs_pair("sd")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "inside")),
  if (rs_pair("mean") > th_part * rs_side("mean", "outside")) "is a sizeable part of the mean figure" else "is a small part of the mean figure") else
  "runstats is not installed, so the effect of the shift was not measured."
rs_agree_txt <- if (!have_rs) "" else if (rs_within(rs_side("mean", "outside"), rs_main[["mean"]]) && rs_within(rs_side("sd", "outside"), rs_main[["sd"]]))
  "The unshifted figures of that chunk agree with the tables'." else
  sprintf("The unshifted figures of that chunk (%s and %s ms) are not the tables' (%s and %s ms): the same call took different times in two chunks of this render, which this report does not explain. The tables' figures are the ones reported; from the side chunk only the paired difference is used.",
          fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_main[["sd"]]))

# core placement: what pinning shows, which calls run on one thread, and the
# cross-check of the one-thread RcppRoll cells. The paragraph itself is in the
# "Hardware and versions" section; these are its data-dependent pieces.
core <- bench_cores$timings
core_ok <- !is.null(core) && all(c("fast", "slow") %in% core$kind)
core_med <- function(k) if (core_ok) stats::median(core$ms[core$kind == k]) else NA_real_
core_row <- function(k) if (core_ok) core[core$kind == k, ][1, ] else list(n_cpus = NA, mhz = NA)
core_fast <- core_row("fast"); core_slow <- core_row("slow")
core_ratio <- core_med("slow") / core_med("fast")
core_matters <- isTRUE(core_ratio >= th_core)
core_effect_txt <- if (core_matters) sprintf("landing on a slow core can cost a single-threaded call up to %s, which is what pinning shows for this one", fmt_x(core_ratio)) else
  "core placement does not matter measurably for that call"

# The calls of the threads table at w=101, named per call: data.table by
# function (frollmean/sum/..., frollapply), any other entry by package, or by
# statistic when only some of its calls are in the group.
thr_main <- thr[thr$kind == "main", ]
calls_other <- function(rows) {
  e_all <- unique(rows$entry[!grepl("^data\\.table", rows$entry)])
  vapply(e_all, function(e) {
    s <- rows$statistic[rows$entry == e]
    if (setequal(s, thr_main$statistic[thr_main$entry == e])) e else sprintf("%s's %s", e, paste(s, collapse = "/"))
  }, "")
}
calls_dt <- function(rows) {
  d <- rows[grepl("^data\\.table", rows$entry), ]
  if (nrow(d)) paste0("data.table's ", froll_group(d)) else character()
}
single_rows <- thr_main[thr_main$class == "flat", ]
multi_rows <- thr_main[thr_main$class != "flat", ]
# the packages without a thread control are single-threaded by the static check above
# groups are separated by semicolons, since data.table's group is a list itself
single_other <- c(calls_other(single_rows), unctl, if (ver[["runstats"]] != "not installed") "runstats")
single_calls_txt <- paste(c(if (length(single_other)) join_and(single_other), calls_dt(single_rows)), collapse = "; ")
multi_other <- calls_other(multi_rows)
multi_calls_txt <- paste(c(if (length(multi_other)) join_and(multi_other), calls_dt(multi_rows)), collapse = "; ")
multi_txt <- if (nrow(multi_rows)) sprintf("The calls the threads table shows using more than one thread (%s) can use both kinds of core.", multi_calls_txt) else
  "No call in the threads table uses more than one thread."
dt_agree_txt <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("data.table's default and one-thread timings of its single-threaded calls (%s) are within %s of each other.",
                                           froll_group(dt_flat), within_pct(dt_flat$ratio)) else ""

# the cross-check: the table's one-thread RcppRoll mean against the 1e7-row
# rate and the two pinned figures; the sentence names the figures it agrees with
within_x <- function(a, b) isTRUE(a / b <= th_x && a / b >= 1 / th_x)
x_apart <- function(a, b) fmt_x(max(a, b) / min(a, b), 2)
xc_main <- med("mean", "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid)
xc_ext <- ext_med("ungrouped mean", "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid) * n_rows / ext_rows
xc_ext_ok <- within_x(xc_main, xc_ext)
xc_fast_ok <- within_x(xc_main, core_med("fast")); xc_slow_ok <- within_x(xc_main, core_med("slow"))
xc_ok <- xc_ext_ok && (!core_ok || xc_fast_ok || xc_slow_ok)
xc_core_figs <- if (core_ok) sprintf(", %s ms on a fast core and %s ms on a slow one", fmt_ms(core_med("fast")), fmt_ms(core_med("slow"))) else ""
xc_figs <- c(ext = sprintf("the %s-row rate", ext_txt), fast = "the fast-core figure", slow = "the slow-core figure")
xc_vals <- c(ext = xc_ext, fast = core_med("fast"), slow = core_med("slow"))
xc_hit <- c(ext = xc_ext_ok, fast = xc_fast_ok, slow = xc_slow_ok)
xc_have <- !is.na(xc_vals)
xc_miss <- names(xc_vals)[xc_have & !xc_hit]
xc_miss_txt <- join_and(vapply(xc_miss, function(k) sprintf("%s away from %s", x_apart(xc_main, xc_vals[[k]]), xc_figs[[k]]), ""))
xc_hits <- xc_figs[xc_have & xc_hit]
xc_agree_txt <- if (length(xc_hits)) sprintf("agrees with %s within a factor of %s", join_and(xc_hits), th_x) else ""
xc_verdict <- if (is.na(xc_main)) {
  "RcppRoll's one-thread mean was not timed at this width, so there is nothing to cross-check."
} else if (!xc_ok) {
  sprintf("The table figure %s%s, so the one-thread RcppRoll cells of this render are suspect and the run should be repeated.",
          if (nzchar(xc_agree_txt)) paste(xc_agree_txt, "but is ") else "is ", xc_miss_txt)
} else {
  paste0("The table figure ", xc_agree_txt,
         if (length(xc_miss)) paste0(" and is ", xc_miss_txt) else "",
         if (!core_ok) "." else if (xc_fast_ok && !xc_slow_ok) ", so this render's one-thread RcppRoll cell ran at fast-core speed." else
           if (xc_slow_ok && !xc_fast_ok) ", so this render's one-thread RcppRoll cell ran at slow-core speed." else
           "; the two pinned figures are too close to tell which kind of core it ran on.")
}

# the one call this render timed twice in different chunks
rs_moved_txt <- if (!have_rs) "" else if (!rs_within(rs_main[["mean"]], rs_side("mean", "outside")))
  sprintf("One call did move between chunks: the runstats mean call took %s ms in the results table and %s ms in chunk %s of the same render (%s apart). This report does not establish why; core placement is a possible cause, not a shown one.",
          fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), code("bench-runstats-shift"), x_apart(rs_main[["mean"]], rs_side("mean", "outside"))) else
  sprintf("The runstats mean call, timed in two chunks of this render, took %s ms in the results table and %s ms in chunk %s.",
          fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), code("bench-runstats-shift"))
n_cells <- nrow(cr); n_ok <- sum(cr$ok); n_err <- sum(grepl("^error:", cr$note))
n_cells_all <- n_cells + n_skip_main
bad <- cr[!cr$ok, ]
alias_diff <- unlist(lapply(setdiff(stats_main, "median"), function(s) vapply(widths, function(w) med(s, "cuplyr (froll alias)", w) - med(s, "cuplyr", w), 0)))
# cells where either entry was not timed are not compared
alias_diff <- alias_diff[!is.na(alias_diff)]
alias_txt <- if (!length(alias_diff)) "no cell has both entries timed, so the two were not compared" else if (all(alias_diff > 0)) sprintf("the alias was %s-%s ms slower than native in each of the %s cells, i.e. within %s ms", fmt_ms(min(alias_diff)), fmt_ms(max(alias_diff)), length(alias_diff), format(ceiling(max(alias_diff) * 10) / 10)) else
  sprintf("the alias differed from native by %s to %s ms across %s cells (slower in %s of them)", fmt_ms(min(alias_diff)), fmt_ms(max(alias_diff)), length(alias_diff), sum(alias_diff > 0))
n_caught <- sum(cr$fell_back %in% TRUE)
skip_intro <- if (n_skip) "These cells were not timed; the reason is the message of the probe call. None of them has a row in `timings.csv` or `correctness.csv`; they are listed in `skipped.csv`." else "No cell was skipped in this run, so there is nothing to list."
median_panel_txt <- if (median_skipped) "The median table and plot carry a note instead of a cuplyr number, because that call is not timed; every cuplyr entry that is timed is computation only." else "Every cuplyr entry is computation only."
denom_txt <- if (n_skip_main == 0) "No cell was skipped, so it is every cell the benchmark planned." else
  sprintf("%s planned %s skipped as CPU fallbacks and are neither timed nor checked, so the count is %s, not %s.", cap1(words(n_skip_main)), plural(n_skip_main, "cell was", "cells were"), n_cells, n_cells_all)
skip_count_txt <- if (!n_skip) "No cell was skipped in this run." else
  sprintf("%s %s skipped in this run: %s; they are listed in the table below and in `skipped.csv`.", cap1(words(n_skip)), plural(n_skip, "cell was", "cells were"), skip_summary)
caught_txt <- if (n_caught == 0) "none was raised by a timed cell" else sprintf("%s raised by a timed cell, which is a bug in the probe and invalidates that cell", words(n_caught))
median_entry_txt <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("There is no cuplyr median entry: %s has no cudf kernel in %s and runs through an R loop on collected data, so it is not timed.", code("roll_median()"), cudf_ver_short) else
  "The median has a native cuplyr entry in this run."
dt_med_rng <- range_ms(med_w("median", "data.table"))

# ---- install logs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
logs <- sort(list.files(params$out_dir, pattern = "^install.*\\.log$"))
log_failed <- lapply(logs, function(f) {
  l <- readLines(file.path(params$out_dir, f), warn = FALSE)
  m <- regmatches(l, regexec("^\\s*(\\S+)\\s+(?:<NA>|\\S+)\\s+not run: install failed", l))
  unique(vapply(Filter(length, m), function(z) z[2], ""))
})
log_notes <- c("install-attempt1-pixi-toolchain.log" = "", "install-attempt2-path-only.log" = "PATH only",
               "install-attempt3-env.log" = "roll via RcppParallel's TBB configure, runstats via missing fftwtools, RollingWindow format-security",
               "install-attempt4.log" = "RollingWindow only: the first flag attempt, PKG_CXXFLAGS, did not override the later -Werror",
               "install.log" = "final run")
log_table <- data.frame(log = logs, failed = vapply(log_failed, function(z) if (length(z)) paste(z, collapse = ", ") else "none", ""),
                        note = ifelse(logs %in% names(log_notes), log_notes[logs], ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
all_installed <- all(ver[bench_pkgs] != "not installed")
missing_pkgs <- names(ver)[ver == "not installed"]
last_clean <- length(logs) > 0 && length(log_failed[[length(logs)]]) == 0
install_lead <- if (all_installed) "Everything the benchmark needs is installed; nothing is \"not run: install failed\"" else
  sprintf("These packages are not installed, so their entries are missing: %s", join_and(missing_pkgs))
knitr_dir <- dirname(find.package("knitr")); rmd_dir <- dirname(find.package("rmarkdown"))
deps_where <- unique(c(knitr_dir, rmd_dir))
deps_in_lib <- all(normalizePath(deps_where, mustWork = FALSE) == normalizePath(params$lib, mustWork = FALSE))
deps_txt <- sprintf("they were found in %s (%s), and rendering this document installs nothing", join_and(code(deps_where)),
                    if (deps_in_lib) "the benchmark library" else "not the benchmark library")
install_runs <- if (length(logs) > 1) sprintf("It took %s install runs because", words(length(logs))) else "The install needed care because"

# ---- the statement about grouping F-findings ---------------------------------------------------------------
worst_stat <- { s <- intersect(c("mean", "sum", "min", "max", "sd"), stats_main); r <- vapply(s, function(z) med(z, "cuplyr", w_hi) / med(z, "cuplyr", w_mid), 0); names(which.max(r)) }
f2_lead <- if (!cup_grow_known) sprintf("Whether the rolling kernels slow down with the window width is not known from this run (%s).", grow_unknown_why) else
  if (cup_grows) sprintf("Rolling kernels slow down with the window width; %s is the worst.", worst_stat) else "Rolling kernels do not slow down strongly with the window width in this run."
u_hi <- function(fn) ext_med("ungrouped mean", fn, w_hi)
dt_med_1t_rng <- range_ms(med_w("median", "data.table (1 thread)"))
ptr_txt <- if (ptr_probe[["dollar_null"]]) paste0("returns NULL (tibble's ", code("$"), "), so helper code has to use ", code(".subset2()")) else
  paste0("works from outside the namespace (checked in this run), so helper code need not use ", code(".subset2()"))
f2_infer <- if (!cup_grow_known) "" else if (cup_grows) "The scaling suggests the kernel rescans each window (inference; not profiled)." else "The widths do not show strong growth in this run, so there is no evidence of a rescan here."
f2_row_if <- if (cup_grows) "Candidate row" else "Candidate row (only if the growth shows up in a later run)"
f3_body <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("%s (%s) loops in R, and it is not timed anywhere in this report. Candidate rows: (a) cheap, call %s (%s here at %s threads, %s at one thread across the three widths) inside the fallback; (b) real, a GPU rolling median (cudf %s has no MEDIAN rolling aggregation).",
  code("roll_apply_generic"), code("R/roll.R"), code("data.table::frollmedian"), dt_med_rng, n_dt_threads, dt_med_1t_rng, cudf_ver_short) else ""
f3_lead <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("%s's CPU fallback is an R loop, not measured in this report.", code("roll_median()")) else
  sprintf("%s has no CPU fallback in this run.", code("roll_median()"))

```{r}
#| label: plots
#| include: false
width_cols <- c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")
plot_interval_widths <- c(0.5, 0.95)
plot_levels <- join_and(fmt_pct(plot_interval_widths, 0))
if (requireNamespace("paletteer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  width_cols <- tryCatch(as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("RColorBrewer::Dark2"))[1:3], error = function(e) width_cols)
}
lab_ms <- function(v) ifelse(v >= 1000, sprintf("%.1f s", v / 1000), sprintf("%.3g ms", v))

# A statistic with a cuplyr cell that was not timed (CPU fallback) carries the
# note as a caption on its plot, and as a row in its table.
skip_fns <- function(stat) unique(sk_main$fn[sk_main$stat == stat & grepl("^cuplyr", sk_main$fn)])

# the caption of a statistic's plot: one note per untimed cuplyr entry,
# wrapped so a long note stays inside the figure
plot_caption <- function(stat) {
  if (!length(skip_fns(stat))) return(NULL)
  paste(vapply(skip_fns(stat), function(f) paste(strwrap(paste0(f, " ", skip_note(stat, f)), width = 90), collapse = "\n"), ""), collapse = "\n")
}
plot_height <- function(stat) {
  d <- main[main$stat == stat, ]
  cap <- plot_caption(stat)
  2 + 0.55 * length(unique(d$fn)) + 0.2 * if (is.null(cap)) 0 else length(strsplit(cap, "\n")[[1]])
}

stat_plot <- function(stat) {
  d <- main[main$stat == stat, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(invisible(NULL))
  med_mid <- tapply(d$ms[d$width == w_mid], d$fn[d$width == w_mid], stats::median)
  ord <- names(sort(med_mid, decreasing = TRUE))
  ord <- c(setdiff(unique(d$fn), ord), ord)
  d$fn <- factor(d$fn, levels = ord)
  d$width_f <- factor(d$width)
  lab <- data.frame(fn = factor(names(med_mid), levels = ord), ms = as.numeric(med_mid), label = lab_ms(as.numeric(med_mid)))
  sub <- paste0("point = median, bars = ", paste(fmt_pct(plot_interval_widths, 0), collapse = " / "), " of samples; label = median at width ", w_mid, "\n",
                "(1 thread) = same call with that package's thread count set to 1\n",
                "cuplyr: computation only, data already on the GPU, no upload/download")
  cap <- plot_caption(stat)
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = ms, y = fn, colour = width_f))
  if (requireNamespace("ggdist", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p <- p + ggdist::stat_pointinterval(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.6), .width = plot_interval_widths, point_size = 1.8)
  } else {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_boxplot(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.5)
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = lab, ggplot2::aes(x = ms, y = fn, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.35, size = 3) +
    # room on the right for the label of the slowest entry
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE),
                           expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.22))) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = width_cols, name = "window width") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "time per call, ms (log10)", y = NULL,
                  title = paste0("Rolling ", stat, ", n = ", format(n_rows, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",")), subtitle = sub, caption = cap) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
                   plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
                   panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

ext_sub <- "computation only, data already on the GPU (cuplyr); no upload/download.\nBars/points = median; error bars = IQR; (1 thread) = threads set to 1"
ext_panels <- function() {
  d1 <- ext[ext$experiment == "grouped mean", ]
  d2 <- ext[ext$experiment != "grouped mean", ]
  d2$one_thread <- grepl("1 thread", d2$fn)
  panels <- list()
  if (nrow(d1)) panels[[1]] <- ggplot2::ggplot(d1, ggplot2::aes(x = median_ms, y = stats::reorder(fn, -median_ms))) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = width_cols[1]) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(xmin = q25_ms, xmax = q75_ms), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = lab_ms(median_ms)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "median ms (IQR bars)", y = NULL,
                  title = paste0("Grouped rolling mean, ", format(group_rows, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ","), " rows, ", n_groups, " groups, w = ", group_width),
                  subtitle = ext_sub) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) + ggplot2::theme(plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))
  if (nrow(d2)) panels[[length(panels) + 1]] <- ggplot2::ggplot(d2, ggplot2::aes(x = width, y = median_ms, colour = fn, group = fn, linetype = one_thread)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +

    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))

}
ext_plot <- function() patchwork::wrap_plots(ext_panels(), ncol = 1)
ext_plot_height <- 3.4 * length(ext_panels()) + 0.5

# ---- tables -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cell_txt <- function(stat, fn, width) {
  i <- cell_i(stat, fn, width)
  if (!is.na(i)) return(sprintf("%s (%s-%s) n=%d", fmt_ms(cells$med[i]), fmt_ms(cells$q25[i]), fmt_ms(cells$q75[i]), cells$n[i]))
  if (width %in% skip_widths(stat, fn)) return("not timed (CPU fallback)")
  if (any(cr$stat == stat & cr$fn == fn & cr$width == width & grepl("^error:", cr$note))) return("error (see Correctness)")
  ""
}
stat_table <- function(stat) {
  fns <- unique(c(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat], cr$fn[cr$stat == stat]))
  if (!length(fns) && !length(skip_fns(stat))) return(invisible(NULL))
  fns <- fns[order(vapply(fns, function(f) med(stat, f, w_mid), 0))]
  out <- data.frame(`function` = fns, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (w in widths) out[[paste0("w=", w)]] <- vapply(fns, function(f) cell_txt(stat, f, w), "")
  # cuplyr entries that were not timed at any width: a row saying so, not a
  # number (a partial skip shows in the entry's own row)
  for (f in setdiff(skip_fns(stat), fns)) {
    out[nrow(out) + 1, ] <- c(f, skip_note(stat, f), rep("not timed", length(widths) - 1))
  }
  knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

Redo of <https://roald-arboel.com/blog/posts/2024/10/03/Benchmark-rolling/> with cuplyr added as one more entry in every statistic panel. Produced by this document (`bench/rolling-window.qmd`; helpers in `bench/rolling-lib.R`, installs in `bench/install-deps.R`): the code that produces every number, table and figure is in the same file as the prose, and every number in the prose is computed from the results. Raw data, written to `r params$out_dir` on every render: `timings.csv`, `correctness.csv`, `extension.csv`, `versions.csv`, `memory-breakdown.csv`, `memory-finding.csv`, `skipped.csv`.

**Run configuration:** cell budget `r cell_budget` s, probe limit `r probe_limit` s, `times` `r times`, `times_custom` `r times_c`, `ext_times` `r ext_times`. `r cfg_txt`. See "How to render" at the end for the command.

Wall time of the timing chunks, which hold the GPU: **`r fmt_dur(wall_secs)`** (`r paste0(names(secs_by_chunk), " ", fmt_dur(secs_by_chunk), collapse = ", ")`; the elapsed times of the run that produced the cached results). Every number below is computed in this document from those results.

## Read this first: what the numbers are

**What cuplyr's number is.** The cuplyr timing is the **computation on a table that is already on the GPU**: `res <- compute(mutate(gt, r = roll_mean(x, n)))` followed by a one-row device-to-host copy as a fence, with `gt <- tbl_gpu(df)` built once outside timing. By decision (Theo, 2026-10-21) it contains **no upload and no `collect()`**. The CPU packages operate on an R vector already in memory, so both sides time the computation only. A real pipeline that starts and ends in R would also pay the PCIe transfers that are excluded here (not measured in this study). `r only_native_txt`

**What the CPU numbers are: measured thread behaviour, not settings.** Package thread settings do not say what a call did, so each multi-thread-capable entry (data.table, RcppRoll, roll) was timed twice, at its default setting and with its threads set to one (entries labelled `(1 thread)`), and the "Threads actually used" section reports both. The result:

- **RcppRoll `r rr_runs` `r n_rr_threads` OpenMP threads by default** (`RcppRoll::roll_threads()` = `r n_rr_threads`) and `r rr_claim`.
- **`r dt_lead`** (default vs `setDTthreads(1)` within `r dt_within`), although `getDTthreads()` is `r n_dt_threads`. `r dt_only` `r dt_weak_txt`
- **`r roll_lead`** `r roll_claim`. `r roll_omp_txt`
- `r join_and(unctl)` were not given a thread control. `r unctl_check`

So there is no blanket "GPU against N CPU threads" framing in this report: the comparison is to the per-entry thread behaviour above. Medians are reported with their spread (IQR in the tables, all samples in `timings.csv`). No headline speedup is claimed.

**What the cuplyr number still includes, per call.** R dispatch of `mutate()`/`compute()`, the AST node builds and schema inference, lowering to C++, **`r words(n_mat_win)` full-table materializations** (an eager window `mutate()` runs `r node_list`, each of which builds a new table, so the input column `x` is deep-copied `r times_word(n_mat_win)` per call; see "Per-call cost breakdown"), allocation of the results and their validity masks, and the fence. The same call on a `r small_txt`-row table, where kernel time is negligible, takes about `r fmt_1(floor_ms)` ms for window functions (a plain `mutate(y = x + 1)` takes `r fmt_1(plain_small)` ms). That floor is `r floor_share_txt` and `r floor_vs_dt` the whole data.table call (`r fmt_ms(med("mean", "data.table", w_mid))` ms). The copy and allocation part grows with the row count and is **inside every `r rows_txt` and `r ext_txt` cuplyr timing** but not in the `r small_txt`-row floor.

## Method

- Data: `rw_data(n)` (`set.seed(12345)` by default, then `rnorm(n)`) with n = `r rows_txt`, no NAs, widths `r widths_slash`, right-aligned, output the same length as the input, `NA` padded. Same functions and arguments as the post (see `rw_functions()` in `bench/rolling-lib.R`), `times` = `r times`, `times` = `r times_c` for the custom function.
- **Deviation 1, one harness for everyone.** The post used `microbenchmark(times = 20)`, which interleaves expressions and does not force a GC. Here every function (CPU packages and cuplyr) goes through `rw_time()`: untimed warmup calls, then `times` samples; an untimed `gc()` runs before every call with the previous result already dropped; each sample is timed with `microbenchmark::get_nanotime()`. `r gc_lead`: an eager `mutate()` holds its GPU intermediates until R finalizes their pointers (finding F1), and `r gc_need_txt`. Applying the same `gc()` to everyone keeps the comparison symmetric. Consequence: no GC ever lands inside a timed region, which in the post's interleaved harness it sometimes did, and deallocation of each result is untimed for every engine (cuplyr's GPU tables are freed with cudaFree inside that untimed `gc()`; the CPU packages' vectors likewise). A test (`tests/testthat/test-bench-F54-harness-extra.R`) pins that `gc()` runs before every call and outside the timed region.
- **Deviation 2, GPU completion.** cuplyr's API gives no "work finished" guarantee (`r sync_txt`). The timed closure ends with `cuplyr:::gpu_head(ptr, 1L, names)`, a one-row pageable copy to the host that synchronizes the stream. The fence adds `r fence_cost` (chunk `bench-fence` timed `r fence_txt`); the call without the fence also leaves the GPU work unfinished, so that difference is an upper bound on the copy's own cost.
- **Deviation 3, slow cells get fewer samples** (`cell_budget` = `r cell_budget` s of timed work per cell). Each cell starts with one cold probe call; its duration sets the sample count through `rw_plan_cell()` (`bench/rolling-lib.R`). A cuplyr cell has one more untimed call before that one, the native probe of the fallback check below, so its "cold" call is its second call and it gets one more warm-up call than the CPU packages. The probe call is *not* a recorded sample (unless it alone exceeds `probe_limit` = `r probe_limit` s, `r probe_txt`); warmup calls (`r warmup_txt`) and then `k` timed calls follow, and the `note` column of `timings.csv` records exactly this per cell. Every cut is listed in the `times` cuts table.
- **Deviation 4, runstats alignment moved out of timing.** `runstats::RunningMean/RunningSd` return left-aligned windows (the window starts at i; the last `n - 1` values are `NA`). The timed closure returns that raw result and only tags it in place (`attr(out, "rw_align") <- "left"`, plus the window width in `rw_window`, on the local fresh vector: no copy). `rw_normalize()` shifts tagged output to right-aligned, outside timing, before the correctness check. So runstats is timed as the package returns it: mean `r fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]])` ms, sd `r fmt_ms(rs_main[["sd"]])` ms at w=`r w_mid` in the results tables. `r rs_txt` `r rs_agree_txt`
- **Deviation 5, argument choices the brief left open.** `RcppRoll::roll_medianr(fill = NA)` is used (right-aligned; plain `roll_median` is centred). The custom function is `sum_custom <- function(x) sum(x)`, a naive window sum (my reading of "unoptimised"; I did not have the post's exact body). Calls: `data.table::frollapply(x, n, sum_custom)` and `zoo::rollapply(x, n, sum_custom, fill = NA, align = "right")`.
- **Single-thread controls.** `data.table (1 thread)` is `setDTthreads(1)` for the cell (restored afterwards); `RcppRoll (1 thread)` is `options(RcppRoll.threads = 1)`; `roll (1 thread)` is `RcppParallel::setThreadOptions(numThreads = 1)` (restored to `"auto"`). The one-thread entry is timed right after its default-thread entry on the same data, through the same harness, and is also checked for correctness. Thread settings as found, before any change: `OMP_NUM_THREADS` `r omp_env`, `getDTthreads()` `r n_dt_threads`, `RcppRoll::roll_threads()` `r n_rr_threads`, `RcppParallel::defaultNumThreads()` `r n_roll_threads` (`versions.csv`).
- **Correctness check (not in the post).** Results are computed outside timing, normalized (`as.numeric`, runstats shifted, left-pad with `NA`) and compared with `data.table::froll<stat>` via `all.equal(tolerance = tol)` (tol = `r tol_txt`) plus identical NA positions. cuplyr results are collected for this check only. A cell whose call errors counts as a failure in the table (it does not drop out of the count); `r if (n_err == 0) "there were none" else paste(words(n_err), "cell(s) errored")`.
- **Fallback check.** Every cuplyr cell is probed before it is timed: one untimed call under `options(cuplyr.fallback = "error")` (`rw_native_probe()` in `bench/rolling-lib.R`). A cell whose probe call falls back to the CPU (cuplyr's "fell back to CPU evaluation" error) is not timed, not checked for correctness and not plotted; it is recorded in the skipped-cells table below and in `skipped.csv`. A probe call that fails for any other reason is not a skip: in the main and extension experiments the cell is recorded as failed (an error row, which counts against the correctness total), and in the overhead, memory and fence chunks it stops the render. `r skip_count_txt` As a second check the timed cells catch `cuplyr_cpu_fallback` conditions: `r caught_txt`.
- cuplyr entries: `cuplyr` is native `roll_<stat>(x, n)` inside `mutate()`; `cuplyr (froll alias)` is `data.table::froll<stat>(x, n)` inside `mutate()` (cuplyr maps it to the same kernel; `r alias_txt`). `r median_entry_txt` Custom: n/a (cuplyr cannot apply an arbitrary R function over windows).
- **Comparison words.** Two medians are "level" when they are within `r fmt_pct(th_level, 0)` of each other, unless their interquartile ranges do not overlap, in which case one is "slightly faster" than the other; outside that band they are "faster" and "slower". A cost "grows" with the window width when the median at w=`r w_hi` is at least `r th_trend` times the median at w=`r w_lo` (it "shrinks" at the inverse ratio and is "flat" in between); slider is "growing" above `r th_grow` times. An entry "scales" with threads at a one-thread over default ratio of at least `r thr_yes`, and does not at `r thr_no` or less. Two figures "agree" within a factor of `r th_x`; a slow core is measurably slower above `r th_core` times; two calls "cost the same" within `r fmt_pct(th_same, 0)`; a custom function is clearly slower above `r th_avoid` times its optimized equivalent; the narrow-window call is "mostly call chain" when it is within `r fmt_pct(th_chain, 0)` of the `cumsum` mutate; a peak is "well inside" the card below `r fmt_pct(th_mem, 0)` of its memory. cuplyr's rank among the entries is "near the front" when its rank divided by the number of entries is at most `r th_front`, "near the back" at `r 1 - th_front` or more and "mid-pack" in between; the runstats alignment shift is "a sizeable part" of the mean figure when it adds more than `r fmt_pct(th_part, 0)` to it.

## Install results

`r install_lead`. `r install_runs` the pixi environment puts a conda gcc first on `PATH`, and that gcc cannot link against the distro R's `Makeconf` (`-latomic_asneeded` unknown, `__libc_csu_init` missing from the conda sysroot): every package that links Fortran/BLAS (quadprog, RcppArmadillo) or configures TBB (RcppParallel, hence roll) failed in the first runs. `bench/install-deps.R` now:

1. puts `/usr/bin` first on `PATH` and sets `CC/CXX/FC` to the system compilers for the install only (override: `BENCH_PIXI_TOOLCHAIN=1`);
2. points RcppParallel at the distro's TBB (`TBB_INC`/`TBB_LIB`);
3. installs `fftwtools` (a runstats dependency; tarball installs do not resolve dependencies) and RcppArmadillo before the runstats tarball;
4. builds RollingWindow with a temporary user Makevars that drops `-Werror=format-security` (its generated `RcppExports.cpp` trips it on current Rcpp).

## Extension: where the GPU should help

Rolling mean, `r ext_times` samples per cell (`r if (all(ext$times == ext_times)) "no cuts" else sprintf("%s cells cut", sum(ext$times != ext_times))`). `peak_gpu_MB` is the peak from `cuplyr:::gpu_alloc_tracking()` around one untimed call; `held_after_MB` is what was still held when that call returned (see F1). `correct` compares with data.table's output. All cuplyr numbers here are computation only, data already on the GPU.

Two experiments: (a) grouped: `r grp_rows_txt` rows, `r groups_txt` interleaved groups, w = `r group_width`; (b) ungrouped: `r ext_txt` rows, w = `r widths_slash`.

#| label: extension-table
ext_tab <- data.frame(
  experiment = ifelse(ext$experiment == "grouped mean", grp_lab, ung_lab), fn = ext$fn, width = ext$width, n_rows = fmt_rows(ext$n_rows),
  median_ms = fmt_ms(ext$median_ms), IQR = paste0(fmt_ms(ext$q25_ms), "-", fmt_ms(ext$q75_ms)), times = ext$times,
  peak_gpu_MB = ifelse(is.na(ext$peak_gpu_bytes), "", sprintf("%.0f", ext$peak_gpu_bytes / 1e6)),
